title: Constructions and Rigidity of Nondegenerate $\mathbb{Z}_2$ Harmonic Functions with Quadric Branching Sets
summary: We study nondegenerate $\mathbb Z_2$ harmonic functions on Euclidean spaces with branching loci given by ellipsoids and planar conics. We first prove that the parameter map associated with Yan's ellipsoidal family is injective. Together with Yan's surjectivity result, this identifies the ellipsoidal models, up to Euclidean motions and overall sign, with nondegenerate harmonic quadratic polynomials of index \(n-1\) and positive critical value.
